purpose.summary: This is a patient registration screen editing and SPA (Scratch Pad Area) initialization subprogram for the ORCA (JMA standard receipt/medical billing) system in Japan. It handles patient master data, insurance information, public expense (Kohi) records, and related medical administration data for a clinic/hospital reception workflow. It is invoked with 'INIT' or 'GMN' processing modes to set up or update screen and SPA parameters.
purpose.domain: healthcare/medical billing (Japanese medical insurance claims system)

notable_features: Extensive use of COPY statements for Japanese medical record layouts (CPPTINF, CPPTHKNINF, CPPTKOHINF, etc.)
Japanese EUC or Shift-JIS encoded comments (rendered as latin-1 mojibake in the archived file)
JMA Open Source License header (ORCA project)
LINKAGE SECTION with multiple SPA (Scratch Pad Area) parameters typical of ORCA screen subprograms
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS — uses MCP (Message Control Program) data area instead (MCPDATA.INC, MCPAREA)
Large number of PERFORM statements (329) indicating structured procedural decomposition
Detailed revision history spanning 2001–2009 in comments
verdict.notes: The file is clearly production COBOL from the open-source ORCA Japanese medical billing system (JMA). Comments are in Japanese encoded as EUC-JP or Shift-JIS but decoded as latin-1, causing mojibake. The COPY statements reference many domain-specific copybooks that are not shown. The dialect is consistent with GnuCOBOL or Micro Focus used in the ORCA project. Source is truncated at 16000 chars out of ~201KB total.
